pairs.subject: codebase-scanning
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/AntiPatternsTab.tsx:63 The Codebase Archeologist list shows at most 100 findings, but the count line above it (line 52) still says '{hits.length} issues' and never says 'top 100 of N', so the cut is hidden. The golden path calls a silently clipped list 'a lie about the backlog'.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/ChurnTab.tsx:16 The git-churn sensor's catch-all (src/lib/codebase-archeologist.ts:323, 'Not a git repo or git not available — return empty') turns a failed read into an empty array. The UI then reports that as a fact about the target ('No git history found') instead of saying the sensor was skipped, and the High Churn card shows 0.

src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:50 Each sweep replaces the previous result wholesale. Nothing persists, there is no ack or dedup across sweeps, and there is no cleared/regressed/persisted verdict. Hit ids are a per-process counter (lib:75 `ap-${++nextId}`), not a stable identity.

src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/index.tsx:91 The headline publishes only the emission count. No count of independent causes sits beside it. OverviewTab:8 also derives the health score from raw emission counts.

src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/OverviewTab.tsx:19 totalFiles is counted after the file walk has already trimmed the population: depth cap 8, SKIP_DIRS, and a 2000-file safety cap at lib:59. None of this is disclosed, so the population reads as if it were the whole tree.

src/components/modules/evaluator/CodebaseArcheologistView/constants.ts:23 The six regex detectors ship with no measured precision recorded anywhere. A grep for 'precision|false.positive' over src/lib/codebase-archeologist.ts and its route found nothing.

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/MappingStrip.tsx:23 The hand-declared checklist→feature mapping is audited for rot: mapped entries that match nothing in the scan, plus unmapped and heuristic items, are surfaced instead of silently shrinking the population.

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/ModuleCard.tsx:83 Each per-module judgment carries its own coverage ('X of Y features scanned'), so the number is not borrowed from the global report.

pairs.registryProposal: The sensor-pipeline technique says 'cap with disclosed truncation' at the pipeline stage. Here the undisclosed cap is added by the render layer (a view-side slice) on top of a server-side cap (backlog.slice(0, 50)). The technique could say outright that every later restriction, including a UI list slice, owes the same 'top N of M' disclosure, which ties it to the-narrowest-view-owns-the-number.
